brief: A 1990s village municipal building: a long single-storey hall of cream vertical steel siding under a grey gable roof, a lettered sign band over the glazed entrance, blue-framed windows, flower beds and a flagpole. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
